meta.title: Fish Export Markets: Gulf and Beyond
meta.description: Fresh fish supply for importers and distributors in the Gulf and other markets, shaped around each destination's specifications and import rules.

hero.title: Export partnerships shaped around each market
hero.intro: We work with importers and distributors across our markets, with close attention to Gulf commercial requirements, documentation and product specifications.

proposition.title: Every market has different requirements
proposition.intro: Successful supply does not start when the shipment arrives. It starts with understanding customer preferences, technical specifications, import rules and packing requirements in each destination.

points.title: Specifications
points.text: Species, size grades and presentation agreed per buyer and per market.

points.title: Packing and labels
points.text: Packing and labelling discussed against what your market and customers expect.

points.title: Documents
points.text: Export documents reviewed for each destination as part of the commercial offer.

active.title: Where we supply today
active.intro: Countries listed here are markets with current export activity. Select a country to start an enquiry with the destination already filled in.
active.gulf_focus: We welcome enquiries from importers and distributors in Kuwait, the UAE, Bahrain and Qatar, subject to supply availability and destination regulations.

other.title: Paused and planned markets
other.intro: Shown separately so that current activity is never overstated. A planned market is not a market we supply today.
other.new_destination: Your country is not listed? You can still send a request: we review new destinations case by case.

steps.title: Request
steps.text: You send the species, specification, volume, destination and timing.

steps.title: Specification and compliance review
steps.text: We check the request against availability, plant capability and the destination's requirements.

steps.title: Quotation
steps.text: Price, quantity, packing, terms and offer validity are set out in a formal quotation.

steps.title: Coordination
steps.text: After agreement, both sides coordinate production timing, packing and transport.

steps.title: Shipping documents
steps.text: The export documents agreed for the destination are prepared with the shipment.

transport.title: How fish travels
transport.intro: Fresh fish is shipped chilled. The transport mode for each destination is confirmed in the quotation.

modes.title: Air freight
modes.text: Chilled fish packed for air cargo, for destinations served by air.

modes.title: Road transport
modes.text: Refrigerated road transport where the destination is reachable by land.

transport.note: We do not publish fixed transit times: schedules depend on the destination, route and booking, and are confirmed per shipment.

support.title: Documents and responsibilities

items.title: Documents per destination
items.text: Tell us which documents your authorities and customers require. We confirm what we can provide when we review your request.

items.title: Clear responsibilities
items.text: Who handles export documents, import clearance and delivery is set out in the quotation and contract, not assumed.

items.title: Working with new distributors
items.text: If you are a distributor or importer looking for a supply partner, tell us about your company, sales channels and expected buying programme.

support.guide_link: Read the guide to importing fresh fish from Egypt

disclaimer: Being ready to export does not mean a permit is automatically available for every market or species. All operations are subject to approvals, availability and contract terms.

cta.title: Discuss your destination with the export team
cta.intro: Share your country, products and expected volumes. We review the destination requirements with you before any commitment.
